Our Philosophy

V & R Studio helps realise your dreams of a perfect home — whether it's your very first, a second retreat, or an investment property ready to rent. From modern classic elegance and Chinoiserie charm to 19th-century French interiors, we guide you through every step so that the process feels simple, personal, and never overwhelming.

Behind V & R Studio are two founders whose expertise sets us apart. One serves as a board member of various art museums across North America, bringing a deep understanding of art, aesthetics, and cultural heritage to every project. The other is an internationally recognised designer with over two million followers, whose portfolio includes collaborations with Apple, Louis Vuitton, Samsung, and Disney — a guarantee of the creative talent behind every home we touch.

Since 2008, we have built a trusted network of vetted contractors, artisans, and real human artists who work with us to bring each home to life — from sourcing materials and managing renovations to creating original artwork, paintings, and murals custom-made for your space. Everything is handled in one place, so you never have to chase down separate vendors or wonder who to call next.

If you are buying your first home, we know how daunting it can feel — the unfamiliar decisions, the fear of hiring the wrong people, the worry that something will go wrong. That is exactly why we exist. We walk beside you from the very beginning, take care of the details, and make sure you feel confident every step of the way.

For investors, every property we complete comes with professional photography and video, ready for you to list or rent online the moment we hand over the keys. You receive not just a finished home, but a market-ready asset.

This profound understanding of art, design, and craftsmanship — down to the smallest detail — constitutes the unique strength of V & R Studio.

Pricing

Packages

$99

First 1:1 Consultation

A one-hour private session with our creative director to discuss your vision, walk through your space, and outline what's possible — whether you're furnishing your first home or reimagining an existing one. You'll leave with a clear sense of direction and an honest estimate before committing to anything further.

FROM $25K

Signature Room

One statement space that changes everything. Includes one custom artwork and a full photo and video package.

FROM $75K

Full Home Transformation

End-to-end art direction across your entire home. Multiple commissions, complete renovation management, and professional documentation.

$2K / MONTH

Ongoing Curation

Seasonal art rotations, event styling, and priority access. Quarterly refreshes to keep your home feeling alive.

The Process

A four-phase creative journey.

01

Discovery

Deep conversation about your life, heritage, and what you want to feel when you walk in the door.

02

Vision Deck

A bespoke mood board and spatial concept unique to you. Signed as your creative contract.

03

Execution

Sourcing, commissions, and installation.

04

The Reveal

Your home enters the world with a professional photo and video package for social posting or listing.
